description: This Python script generates privapp permissions XML files for Android priv-apps, either from local APKs or connected devices, by analyzing AndroidManifest.xml files and permissions.

classes.name: Adb
classes.description: Wrapper class for ADB commands, handling device communication and file transfer.

classes.name: Aapt
classes.description: Wrapper class for Android Asset Packaging Tool (aapt) commands.

classes.name: Resources
classes.description: Contains methods and attributes to resolve and manage Android system resources, APKs, and device connections.

methods.name: parse_args
methods.description: Parses command-line arguments for the script.

methods.name: create_permission_file
methods.description: Generates and outputs or writes permission XML files based on resources.

methods.name: generate_missing_permissions
methods.description: Computes permissions that are missing for each app in a partition.

methods.name: print_xml
methods.description: Outputs permission data as XML to a file or stdout.

methods.name: extract_pkg_and_requested_permissions
methods.description: Extracts package name and requested permissions from an APK using aapt.

methods.name: extract_priv_permissions
methods.description: Extracts privileged permissions from an APK's AndroidManifest.xml.
